# Astronomical 0.2.86
Run bigger local mixture-of-experts models on Apple Silicon. This patch release improves how Astronomical balances sparse-expert weights across RAM and SSD, and makes that balance visible and trustworthy in the native Observatory menu.
## What is new
- **New Observatory Experts view.** A single console handler now boots the Experts view, reporting the resident versus SSD-streamed expert split directly in the native menu. - **Honest expert-streaming statistics.** Expert demand statistics are now split by serving phase, and accumulated usage is persisted across sessions so the streamed figures reflect actual serving behavior. - **Self-healing residency.** When the complete sparse payload fits the configured ceiling, Astronomical measures prefill residency churn and drops the SSD stream slot, returning the model to fully resident memory. - **Continuity across worker replacement.** The raised MLX memory ceiling is kept across worker hot-swaps, and the worker survives expert-streaming statistics that arrive during a cancellation.
## Compatibility
- Backward-compatible patch. The Stable and Development configurations and their loopback endpoints are unchanged. - Requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later on Apple silicon.
